records.source: There is an aura of coldness around this crystal.
records.translation: May malamig na aura sa paligid ng kristal na ito.

records.source: A pale, blind fish found in underground lakes.
records.translation: Maputla at bulag na isdang matatagpuan sa mga lawa sa ilalim ng lupa.

records.source: This sharp, spicy root is said to increase vitality.
records.translation: Sinasabing pinatataas ng matapang at maanghang na ugat na ito ang sigla.

records.source: A zesty soda known for its soothing effect on the stomach.
records.translation: Maanghang-anghang na soda na kilala sa nakagiginhawang epekto sa sikmura.

records.source: Builds a nest on the underside of glaciers.
records.translation: Gumagawa ng pugad sa ilalim ng mga glasyar.

records.source: The original Glacierfish had a son...
records.translation: Nagkaroon ng anak na lalaki ang unang Isdang Glasyar...

records.source: A mixture of glass shards smoothed by centuries of ocean surf. These could have belonged to an ancient mosaic or necklace.
records.translation: Mga tipak ng salaming pinakinis ng ilang siglo ng hampas ng alon. Maaaring bahagi ang mga ito ng sinaunang mosaiko o kuwintas.

records.source: Sweet and satisfying... The sugar gives it a hint of caramel.
records.translation: Matamis at nakakabusog... Nagbibigay ang asukal ng bahagyang lasang karamelo.

records.source: Emits a constant light, and also increases your radius for collecting items.
records.translation: Patuloy na naglalabas ng liwanag at pinalalaki rin ang abot ng iyong pagkuha ng mga bagay.

records.source: Soft cheese made from goat's milk.
records.translation: Malambot na kesong gawa sa gatas ng kambing.

records.source: Some types of Gobies can climb up waterfalls.
records.translation: May ilang uri ng biya na nakaaakyat sa mga talon.

records.source: Give this to a farm animal to permanently double its produce yield. Doesn't work on pigs.
records.translation: Ibigay ito sa hayop sa bukid upang permanenteng madoble ang dami ng produkto nito. Hindi gumagana sa mga baboy.

records.source: This is one tough nut to crack, but a professional might be able to break it open.
records.translation: Napakatigas basagin ng niyog na ito, ngunit baka kayang buksan ng isang propesyonal.

records.source: A very rare and special egg with a solid gold shell.
records.translation: Napakabihira at natatanging itlog na may balat na purong ginto.

records.source: A creepy golden mask probably used in an ancient magic ritual. A socket in the forehead contains a large purple gemstone.
records.translation: Nakatatakot na ginintuang maskara na malamang ginamit sa sinaunang mahiwagang ritwal. May malaking lilang hiyas sa puwang sa noo.
